verdict.rationale: Bitwarden publishes a first-party MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server, GPL-3.0, on npm). A runtime probe confirmed it completes a full keyless stdio initialize handshake via `npx -y @bitwarden/mcp-server`, returning serverInfo "Bitwarden MCP Server" 2026.7.0. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the server's exposed tools, scope and auth setup in the pack, and evidence of an agent actually performing vault operations through it beyond the handshake.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
